titel: Click Cuts, eerste beeld lanceer-Short (paard voor en na, echte Blender-opname)
rol: You make or download 3D models and print them at home, and many models are bigger than your printer bed. You are scrolling YouTube Shorts and YouTube videos about Blender and 3D printing. Which of these first frames makes you stop and watch?
